name: mg-annual-property-tax
description: Prepare Madagascar annual land and built-property tax working papers for 2026 from the official IFT and IFPB provisions. Use this Guide when asked about municipal property tax, vacant urban land, agricultural land categories, owner-occupied principal homes, rented buildings, new construction exemptions, rental valuation or the annual property declaration. It separates national computation rules from the commune's missing tariff, valuation and flat-charge decisions. It also distinguishes the commune declaration from a fiscal-centre exemption request and preserves the different land and building filing deadlines. July collection-title transition dates, municipal forms, payment references, mining special regimes and transactional property taxes remain outside the executable scope.
